notes: Account summary: Platform engineering org (internal + product teams) evaluating replacing several small in-house assistants with a unified copilot offering.
Primary drivers: predictable monthly spend per active developer, sub-50ms interactive completions, and deterministic behavior for refactors that touch test suites.
Desired pricing model: baseline committed seats with monthly true-up, burst credits for demo days, optional dedicated reserved GPU pools per org unit.

Quality vs cost: strong push to use 4-bit quantization for non-critical suggestions but require automatic promotion to 8-bit or float on fallback/confidence drop; need A/B quantized-to-float rollback thresholds.

Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, immutable audit traces for completions called from private repos, and option to run private control plane in their on-prem cluster.

POC observations: repo-prefix cache gave biggest wins on repeated completions for large monorepos; session KV cache reduced repeated token generation for frequently accessed helper functions.
